description: This PHP source file defines the MTurkClient class for interacting with Amazon Mechanical Turk. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to HITs, qualifications, and worker management, serving as a client wrapper around AWS's MEchanical Turk service.

classes.name: MTurkClient
classes.description: A PHP client class extending AwsClient for Amazon Mechanical Turk operations.

methods.name: acceptQualificationRequest
methods.description: Accepts a qualification request in Mechanical Turk.

methods.name: associateQualificationWithWorker
methods.description: Associates a qualification with a worker.

methods.name: disassociateQualificationFromWorker
methods.description: Disassociates a qualification from a worker.

methods.name: getFileUploadURL
methods.description: Gets a URL for file upload.

methods.name: listAssignmentsForHIT
methods.description: Lists assignments for a specific HIT.

methods.name: listHITsForQualificationType
methods.description: Lists HITs for a qualification type.

methods.name: listReviewPolicyResultsForHIT
methods.description: Lists review policy results for a HIT.

methods.name: listWorkersWithQualificationType
methods.description: Lists workers with a specific qualification type.

methods.name: sendBonus
methods.description: Sends a bonus to a worker.

methods.name: updateHITReviewStatus
methods.description: Updates the review status of a HIT.

methods.name: updateHITTypeOfHIT
methods.description: Updates the HIT type of a HIT.
